---
title: "Generate Plots"
execute:
  echo: true
  output: false
---

This page generates all plots for the Marshall Fire analysis. Plots are only regenerated if they don't already exist.

```{julia}
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(joinpath(@__DIR__, ".."))
Pkg.instantiate()

using MarshallWildfire
using GLMakie

# Set output directory
output_dir = joinpath(@__DIR__, "..", "output")
mkpath(output_dir)
```

## Fire Perimeter

```{julia}
path = joinpath(output_dir, "marshall_fire_perimeter.png")
if !isfile(path)
    @info "Generating marshall_fire_perimeter.png"
    MarshallWildfire.plot_marshall_perimeter(; output_dir)
else
    @info "marshall_fire_perimeter.png already exists"
end
```

## Perimeter with Buildings and Power Lines

```{julia}
path = joinpath(output_dir, "marshall_fire_with_buildings.png")
if !isfile(path)
    @info "Generating marshall_fire_with_buildings.png"
    MarshallWildfire.plot_perimeter_with_buildings(; output_dir)
else
    @info "marshall_fire_with_buildings.png already exists"
end
```

## Landfire Layers

```{julia}
# Check if any landfire plots are missing
lf = MarshallWildfire.get_landfire_data()
missing_layers = filter(k -> !isfile(joinpath(output_dir, "landfire_$k.png")), keys(lf))

if !isempty(missing_layers)
    @info "Generating landfire layer plots"
    MarshallWildfire.plot_landfire_layers(; output_dir)
else
    @info "All landfire layer plots already exist"
end
```

## Summary

All plots have been generated and saved to the `output/` directory.
